content: GDPR/ePrivacy for invite flows: platform-sent refer-a-friend emails need the recipient's consent under ePrivacy (Irish DPC doubts such schemes can comply; Belgian DPA fined an invite-a-friend feature EUR 50k for no legal ground); CNIL position (secondary source): identify the referrer, single use of the address, no retention for other messages without consent. Safest design: sender-initiated sharing from the user's own email/messenger, platform stores nothing about the friend until opt-in.
